About Us

Who We Are

South Sudan's dedicated technology consultancy for IT, cybersecurity, and data solutions.

RosTech Advisory was founded to bridge the gap between international-standard technology services and the realities of operating in South Sudan. We believe every organisation — NGO, government agency, or private business — deserves reliable, affordable, and contextually appropriate technology support.

Our Mission

Making Technology Work Here

We design and deliver technology solutions that account for South Sudan's power infrastructure, connectivity constraints, and human capacity — not solutions that assume conditions that don't exist.

Our Approach

Honest, Measurable, Local

We start every engagement by listening. We document the problem, propose options, explain trade-offs, and only proceed when you're fully informed. Post-delivery, we stay engaged.

Our Values

Transparency & Results

No hidden fees. No scope creep without conversation. No disappearing after delivery. We measure every engagement against the goals we agreed on together at the start.

Services

What We Offer

Comprehensive, affordable technology services for South Sudan's NGOs and businesses.

Cybersecurity Assessment & Training

With cyber threats growing across East Africa, organisations in South Sudan face real risks — from phishing campaigns targeting NGO staff to ransomware aimed at financial systems. RosTech provides practical, affordable cybersecurity support designed for your operating environment.

  • Organisational risk assessments
  • Staff phishing simulation & awareness training
  • Password & access control policy development
  • Incident response planning
  • Device security & endpoint protection
  • Data backup & recovery strategies

IT Infrastructure Setup & Support

Reliable infrastructure is the foundation of any modern organisation. We design and deploy networks, servers, and connectivity solutions that work within South Sudan's realities — including unreliable power and limited last-mile internet connectivity.

  • LAN/WAN network design & installation
  • Server procurement & configuration
  • Wi-Fi setup & optimisation
  • Power-resilient system design (UPS/solar)
  • Hardware procurement & lifecycle management
  • Ongoing helpdesk & maintenance support

Data Management & Analytics

Many organisations in South Sudan collect significant programme data but lack the systems to use it effectively. We build databases, dashboards, and reporting systems that give your team clear, real-time visibility into what matters.

  • Database design & implementation
  • KoBoToolbox / ODK / CommCare integration
  • Power BI & Google Data Studio dashboards
  • Beneficiary management systems
  • Data cleaning & migration services
  • Staff data literacy training

Software Deployment & Support

From ERP systems to custom web applications, we manage the full deployment lifecycle — installation, configuration, user training, and ongoing technical support — so your team can focus on programmes, not technology problems.

  • ERP & HRMS implementation
  • Microsoft 365 & Google Workspace deployment
  • Custom web application development
  • User training & documentation
  • Licensing management & renewals
  • Monthly retainer support packages
  • Web hosting & domain registration
  • Website setup, maintenance & renewals

Case Studies

Work We've Done

Real examples of how RosTech Advisory has helped organisations in South Sudan solve technology challenges.

NGO · Cybersecurity

Securing a Humanitarian Organisation's Field Data

A Juba-based INGO operating across three states had no formal cybersecurity policy and staff regularly shared passwords via WhatsApp. After a phishing incident exposed field staff data, RosTech conducted a full assessment, developed a security policy, and ran organisation-wide awareness training across all field sites.

Zero incidents in 12 months post-training Password manager deployed org-wide Incident response plan adopted
Private Sector · IT Infrastructure

Network Overhaul for a Financial Services Firm

A financial services company in Juba was experiencing daily network outages affecting client transactions. RosTech assessed the existing infrastructure, redesigned the network topology, procured enterprise-grade switches and UPS units, and deployed the new system over a planned weekend to minimise business disruption.

Network uptime increased to 99.2% Downtime reduced by 94% Power-resilient design with 4hr UPS backup
Education · Data Management

Student Data System for a Secondary School Network

A network of secondary schools across Greater Equatoria was managing student records entirely on paper and in disconnected spreadsheets. RosTech designed and deployed a centralised school management system with offline capability, enabling real-time reporting to the central office even in low-connectivity locations.

1,200+ student records digitised Offline-first system with sync Monthly reports cut from 5 days to 2 hours
Health · Software Deployment

KoBoToolbox Rollout for a Health Programme

A health-focused NGO was collecting household survey data on paper across five counties. RosTech managed the full migration to KoBoToolbox — designing the digital forms, training 45 field enumerators, and building a live Power BI dashboard giving programme managers instant access to field data.

45 enumerators trained in 3 days Data lag reduced from 3 weeks to real-time 100% elimination of paper forms

Privacy Policy

How RosTech Advisory handles your information.

Last updated: January 2025

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you voluntarily provide through our contact form or booking modal, including your name, organisation, email address, and message content. We do not use cookies or tracking technologies on this website beyond anonymous, cookieless analytics via Plausible.

2. How We Use Your Information

Information you submit is used solely to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

3. Data Storage

Form submissions are sent directly to our email inbox and are not stored in any third-party database. We retain correspondence for up to 24 months for legitimate business purposes.

4. Analytics

This website uses Plausible Analytics, a privacy-first analytics tool that collects no personal data and uses no cookies. Aggregate traffic data (page views, referrers, device types) is visible only to RosTech Advisory.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal data we hold about you. To exercise these rights, contact us at rostech336@gmail.com.

6. Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect information you provide to us. Our website is served over HTTPS.

7. Contact

For any privacy-related questions, contact RosTech Advisory at rostech336@gmail.com or call +211 929 840 558.
